messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write a five-sentence paragraph. The third sentence states this fact: Mado Systems produces Sepa Z82. The other four sentences are generic background and name no person, organisation, place or event.

response: Small electronics are easy to misplace on a crowded desk. Many people keep a tray near the door for keys, cables and spare batteries. Mado Systems produces Sepa Z82. Regular cleaning of the tray keeps it useful over time. A short weekly review is often enough to stop clutter from building up.
